units.source_text: 源氏公子派人到京中去取来种种物品，自老僧以至诵经诸法师，皆有赏赐。

en.t: Prince Genji sent people to the capital to fetch all sorts of things, and gave rewards to everyone, from the old monk to the priests who chanted the sutras.

units.source_text: 连当地一切人夫童仆都受得布施。

en.t: Even all the local laborers and young servants received alms.

units.source_text: 正在诵经礼佛，准备回驾之时，僧都进入内室，将源氏公子昨夜委托之事详细转达老尼姑。

en.t: While the sutras were being chanted and homage paid to the Buddha, just as they were preparing to return, the bishop went into the inner room and conveyed in detail to the old nun what Prince Genji had entrusted to him the previous night.

units.source_text: 老尼姑说：“不论是否，目下未便草草答复。

en.t: The old nun said, "Whether it is so or not, at present I cannot give a hasty answer.

units.source_text: 倘公子果有此意，也须过四五年再作道理。”

en.t: If the prince truly has such an intention, even then the matter must wait four or five years before being considered again."

units.source_text: 僧都如实转告，公子郁郁不乐，便派僧都身边的侍童送诗与老尼姑：

en.t: When the bishop reported this exactly as it was, the prince fell into gloom, and so he sent a poem to the old nun by way of the attendant boy at the bishop's side:
